topic: The "minimum payment" number on a bill is calculated to look small on purpose -- it is not what a responsible payment looks like
title: The Minimum Payment Is A 20-Year Trap
description:
That small "minimum payment" on your credit card statement isn't a helpful suggestion. It's a calculation designed to keep you in debt for as long as possible, maximizing the interest you pay.

#personalfinance #creditcards #debt #moneytips #credit
